usage: C# Razor page templates for ASP.NET, one DNA each.

csharp_pages.title: Concrete-poem CTA (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: CTA for Inkwell Press, a shared letterpress studio — the headline set as a stepped concrete poem in Major Mono, with a rotated rubber-stamp badge counting the 40 remaining drawers.

csharp_pages.title: Features as spec table (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Features for Karton, an inventory app for small makers — rendered as a numbered Swiss spec table with red index numerals and measured mono specs. No cards at all.

csharp_pages.title: Poster footer (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Footer for Studio Bureau — a swiss-poster sign-off: the wordmark oversized as the image, link columns with hairline rules, and a red contact block. A footer with somewhere to go, not a copyright line.

csharp_pages.title: Editorial hero (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Editorial hero for The Slow Margin, a print quarterly for people who still finish books. Giant Fraunces headline, mono meta row, and one deliberate choice: a colossal clipped issue numeral behind the type.

csharp_pages.title: Railway-ticket login (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Login for Nightline sleeper rail — the form is a punched railway ticket with dashed perforations, a rotated ADMIT ONE stub, and brass accents. Your berth is waiting.

csharp_pages.title: Calm 3-step onboarding (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Onboarding for Halcyon, a calm shared family calendar — a frosted 3-step wizard with a hairline progress rule and one deliberate choice: a slow breathing circle behind the card. Three small steps, then quiet.

csharp_pages.title: Deco menu-board pricing (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Pricing for Velvet Pour, a natural wine club — set as a black-lacquer deco menu board with gold dotted price leaders, a sunburst divider, and one framed house-favorite tier. A menu, not cards.

csharp_pages.title: Instrument settings panel (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Settings for Fieldkit, a wildlife camera-trap companion app — a dense lab-instrument panel with measured mono labels, spec-sheet rows, and real toggle/segmented controls. Every setting changes what the camera does tonight.

csharp_pages.title: Terminal status readout (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: Stats for Hedgehog Host, a small hosting company — delivered as a phosphor-green terminal status readout: sparklines, amber warnings, a blinking block cursor, and a fake tail -f deploy log.

csharp_pages.title: Single ma testimonial (Razor)
csharp_pages.description: One testimonial for Kama Kiln, a ceramics studio — set with deliberate ma: a vertical mono column, one enormous Shippori Mincho quote, and a red hanko stamp as the signature. Emptiness used on purpose.
